notes: The two new candidates were identified while reusing existing crops for open places and were independently confirmed by the main reader. No new image crop was made.

The short pale contour below the LL–S baseline is retained only as visible detached geometry. Its role remains unresolved; faintness alone does not establish deletion or an earlier drawing stage. H’s supplied generic description does not make a local claim about this fragment and is not charged with its omission.

The first relation in (4) is a joined right-cap contour, unlike the later separated equals signs. It is preserved literally under an uncertainty wrapper. This qualifies the interpretation of the first relation; it does not assert that tau0 squared is greater than tau1 squared.

Qualification of existing mathematical records: 142_scan114_A1_inverse_rotations, 142_scan114_A2_commutation and 142_scan114_S_main_product retain their algebraic conclusions under their stated involution assumptions. Their application to this manuscript depends on interpreting the newly qualified first joined relation in (4) as equality, thereby obtaining tau0 squared =1 along with the other involutions. The audit reviewed that wording but performed no new proof or mathematical check; check_events remains empty.

The six pre-existing doubts remain in full: cancelled aux, the overworked surface word, the outer parenthesis in the upper-left positive drawing label, the upper-right R_r^{infinity1} cluster, the possible right head of the L-to-F horizontal segment, and the cancelled extra rho_infinity factor in (5). The two new doubts concern the detached trace’s role and the joined relation’s conventional interpretation.

The drawing reading confirms the current counterclockwise central loop, the separate short upward connector above Ra, the upward connector near the outer right zero, and the curved connection immediately above the lower-right infinity. The overworked rho1(r) label is live; the extra factor in (5) has a separate cancellation. No expected mathematical orientation was used to complete an uncertain head.

The figure’s three edge labels and three lambda labels, all six paired-index R labels including the single explicit comma in 0,1, the neighboring tau/rho formulas and their signs, the light skeleton, and the fine dark S–B side remain represented. The new local pale fragment is inventoried adjacent to the drawing block.
